title: Chapter 192 The Terror Of The Lord Of The Desolate City
content:
Chapter 192 The Terror Of The Lord Of The Desolate City

Wanfeng slowly stood up and then retreated behind Yan Lingyun.

This scene shocked the six leaders of Muling Sect.

Crazy Emperor and Master?

They didn't have this information.

Then, the five people subconsciously looked at Old Fang.

Mr. Fang is a strong man in the same era as the Crazy Emperor, and he must have some understanding of the so-called master of the Crazy Emperor.

"Um?"

The next moment, the five were stunned.

I saw that the location where Mr. Fang was still there just now was empty.

Run away. .

Suddenly, the five people looked ugly.

At this time, Yan Lingyun in the distance was also staring at them with murderous intent.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng spoke.

"I'll do it."

Lu Daosheng slowly headed towards the few people, and his aura suddenly began to surge wildly.

Boom!

For a moment, the entire void began to vibrate.

"you!"

When the five of them noticed Lu Daosheng's terrifying aura, they felt cold in their hearts and had the idea of retreating.

However, as Lu Daosheng's palm pressed down.

An irresistible pressure kept the five people firmly in place.

"You guys listen."

Lu Daosheng spoke slowly.

The sound was not loud, but it spread throughout the spiritual realm!

"I am the lord of Huangcheng City. Anyone who has any objections to my Huangcheng City can come to Huangcheng to find me at any time. I, Lu Daosheng, will definitely treat you personally!"

Buzz —

As Lu Daosheng clenched his fist with one hand, the space where the five leaders of the Mu Ling Sect were immediately distorted.

The next moment.

Bang!

Blood rain poured down from the void.

At the same time, all the aura in the dark disappeared at this moment.

In addition to the spiritual consciousness that came to inquire here, they retreated like a tide.

The entire spiritual realm became quiet at this moment.

The Lord of the Huangcheng City is so terrifying!

"We, pay homage to the city lord!"

In the deserted city, Xun Heng was the first to react and yelled.

Then, the entire deserted city began to tremble.

"Greetings to the Lord of the City!"

......

"Master, Master."

In the city lord's mansion, Wan Feng stood in the hall with fear.

Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun were sitting at the top.

"Wanfeng, you have done a good job. Thank you for your hard work over the years."

Lu Daosheng said with a smile.

Upon hearing this, Wan Feng looked happy, "Master, without you, I am still sealed now. It is Wan Feng's honor to be able to do these things for you."

As soon as these words were spoken, Yan Lingyun's face changed.

"seal?"

"Xiaofeng, what happened?"

Yan Lingyun knew that something must have happened to her apprentice after something happened to her.

But I don’t know what it is.

Immediately, Wan Feng didn't hide anything and told Yan Lingyun about his experience.

"I'm sorry, Master, I'm embarrassing you."

After saying that, Wan Feng lowered his head slightly.

She felt that she was ashamed of Yan Lingyun and failed Yan Lingyun's expectations.

However, at this time, a warm hand fell gently on Wan Feng's head.

"Xiaofeng, it's not your fault for this."

Yan Lingyun's eyes were slightly red and she said softly.

His disciple had been sealed for so many years. If it weren't for Lu Daosheng, he would have been sealed until he came to the fairy world.

Thinking of this, Yan Lingyun was filled with anger.

Turning his head to look at Lu Daosheng.

"Daosheng, those late emperors who participated in that battle could not all die, right?"

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned, not understanding Yan Lingyun's meaning.

"Well, there are still a few who are alive."

Nine Immortal Emperor Realm powerhouses joined forces to seal Anfeng. To this day, three are still in the Wood Immortal Realm.

The rest of the rest were either falling or leaving the Wood Immortal Realm.

When he heard Lu Daosheng's words, Yan Lingyun looked at Wan Feng, "Xiaofeng, you are waiting for me in the deserted city, and I will do something with your master."

After saying that, before Wan Feng could speak, Yan Lingyun had already pulled Lu Daosheng toward the distance.

In place, Wan Feng stared at the backs of the two people blankly, and after a long time, he shook his head and smiled.

"Master, so many years have passed, and you have not changed at all."

What Yan Lingyun is going to do, she can tell with her toes.

Not enough, my master has just returned to the Wood Immortal Realm and his strength is in the early stage of the Immortal Realm. Can it work?

Oh no, if you have a master here, then it will be fine.

Alas, it feels so good that someone protects him.

(Immortal Realm Immortal King Realm Immortal Lord Realm Immortal Lord Realm Immortal Saint Realm Immortal Emperor Realm)

"Lingyun, we don't have to be so anxious, are we?"

Seeing Yan Lingyun's face turned gloomy and silent, Lu Daosheng said with some concern.

His idea is to cultivate Wanfeng. After Wanfeng recovers his strength, he will rely on his own ability to avenge his revenge. That is the best way to do it.

Now, Yan Lingyun looks like this, she wants to kill all the surviving old immortal emperors to vent her anger.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Yan Lingyun stopped immediately and turned her head toward Lu Daosheng.

"That's my apprentice!"

Lu Daosheng, who was yelled, stood there in a daze, staring at Yan Lingyun blankly.

At this moment, he suddenly thought of a long time ago.

I and Yan Lingyun were together not long ago.

At that time, I was very weak, and basically a slightly more powerful cultivator could press himself to beat him. Every time I was beaten, Yan Lingyun was avenging him.

Although it is embarrassing to be protected by women, Lu Daosheng is very happy.

Yan Lingyun is really protective of her.

Once Yan Lingyun thinks someone is important, she will not allow him to be bullied at all.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng felt a little complicated.

He is really not a man.

"Let's go, Lingyun, let's go kill them!"

Lu Daosheng's attitude changed immediately after he figured it out, and he directly pulled Yan Lingyun towards one of the unlucky guys.

However, although Yan Lingyun was slightly surprised, she still did not move.

"Don't rush about this."

"Huh?"

What the hell? ?

I have figured it out, and you are doing this again.

Lu Daosheng looked at Yan Lingyun with a puzzled look.

Being looked at by Lu Daosheng like this, Yan Lingyun coughed lightly, "Take me to a place first, there are some things I left in the Wood Immortal Realm, I need to restore my strength now."

"Let me do the Wanfeng thing."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng also understood.

So you want to do it yourself.

At this time, Yan Lingyun had just ascended, and her strength was still in the early stage of the fairyland. Looking at the entire fairyland, she was a very weak existence.

Then, the two of them crossed the void directly and quickly headed towards the cold area of the wood fairyland.

At the same time.

The atmosphere in several super-terrorist forces in the entire wood fairyland was extremely depressing.

The Huangcheng they were targeting actually had such a terrifying existence.

One strike instantly killed several immortal emperor realm powerhouses.

Among them was even the leader of the Muling Sect in the late stage of the immortal emperor realm.

With such strength, why did they still compete with them for the resources of the wood fairyland, why not march into the central region.

The forces racked their brains to figure it out.

But at this moment, this question is obviously not the most important.

The most important thing at present is whether Huangcheng will punish them.

Although they hid well, they believed that they would not have any secrets in the eyes of the existence of the Huangcheng City Lord.

Now, to be realistic, their fate is already in the hands of Huangcheng.
